modules.label: mGBA (GB / GBC / GBA)
modules.description: Play Game Boy, Game Boy Color and Game Boy Advance games. Recommended default emulator. Select at least one emulator.

modules.label: gpSP (GBA)
modules.description: An alternative emulator for Game Boy Advance games only. Without mGBA, Game Boy and Game Boy Color systems are hidden.

modules.label: Wi-Fi
modules.description: Connect to wireless networks for transfers and online features. Normally starts off each boot; enable it when needed.

modules.label: SSH
modules.description: Control the handheld from a computer using a terminal. Needs Wi-Fi or USB Networking. Remembers your SSH switch within the current boot when a connection returns.

modules.label: File Sharing (SMB)
modules.description: Copy games and saves using your computer's file manager over the network. Needs Wi-Fi or USB Networking.

modules.label: USB Storage
modules.description: Show the games partition as a USB drive on your computer. Safely eject it before returning to Slot.

modules.label: USB Networking
modules.description: Connect by USB to Windows 11, macOS or Linux. Add SSH or File Sharing for access. Internet via USB also needs sharing enabled on the computer.

modules.label: Games from TF1 / TF2
modules.description: Play from TF1 or TF2; inserted cards appear automatically on the shelf. Choose System or Game storage for saves and states. Use the Slot folder layout.

modules.label: Enhanced Audio
modules.description: Optional 48 kHz resampling. Adds an Audio setting, initially Off. Uses a little more CPU. Changes apply the next time you open a game.

modules.label: Shaders and Color Filters
modules.description: Choose per-console shaders, color correction and frame blending. Some effects use more CPU or GPU power.

modules.label: Console Overlays
modules.description: Add console borders around the game, including Slot and Perfect styles. Available styles depend on the system.

modules.label: Frame Counter
modules.description: Show a small frame-rate number while playing. Toggle it with Select + X.

modules.label: Screenshots
modules.description: Capture games with Select + Start. Configure shaders, screen filters and overlays in System. Copy PNG images from Screenshots using a card reader or USB Storage; Gallery is optional.

modules.label: Gallery
modules.description: Browse screenshots on the handheld. Sort by game, date or platform, view full screen and delete images with confirmation. Screenshots capture is a separate optional feature.

modules.label: Rewind
modules.description: Move backward through recent gameplay by holding L2. Uses extra memory and processing while recording.

modules.label: Run-Ahead
modules.description: Reduce input delay in GBA games using mGBA. Uses more CPU and can reduce speed in demanding games. Unavailable with gpSP only.

modules.label: Automatic Network Time
modules.description: Set the clock from the internet using Wi-Fi or Internet via USB. USB needs internet sharing on the computer. Manual clock setting stays available.

modules.label: OTA Updates
modules.description: Download small signed updates in order, continuing after restarts. Preserves installed features and a rollback version. Needs internet access.

modules.label: Diagnostics
modules.description: View available RAM, temperature, storage, versions and service status. Readings refresh while Diagnostics is open.

modules.label: SD Storage Check / Repair
modules.description: Manually check or repair SD games storage. Repair needs confirmation and changes filesystem metadata. Back up first. Internal eMMC and system partitions stay protected.

modules.label: Schedutil Governor
modules.description: Add a System switch for an alternative CPU power policy. Initially Off: ondemand 20 ms stays the default. Battery savings vary by game. CPU speed limits stay unchanged.

modules.label: Development Profilers
modules.description: Add boot-timing and process-usage tools for development. Recording is enabled separately when investigating an issue.

modules.label: Developer Mode
modules.description: Add a Developer Mode switch that keeps network access and SSH available across restarts. Requires SSH and Wi-Fi or USB Networking.
